items.title: 5 Large Cap Tech Stocks to Buy According to Billionaires
items.summary: The recent selloff in technology stocks has raised questions about how much investors are willing to pay for growth, particularly as the cost of expanding AI infrastructure continues to rise. Even established technology companies have not been immune. In late October, Fortinet and ServiceNow suffered steep single-day share-price declines as investors questioned their growth prospects […]

items.title: ServiceNow Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Growth and Outlook Risks
items.summary: ServiceNow raises its AI contract value target to $1.7B as adoption accelerates, while slower backlog growth and revenue adjustments raise outlook questions.

items.title: SoundHound AI Signed a Deal With LG. Thursday’s Report Has to Show Its Losses Are Shrinking
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSoundHound AI reports third-quarter results after the close on Thursday, two days after announcing a deal to bring restaurant ordering to about 20 million LG smart TVs in the US. Second-quarter revenue grew 45%, but the operating loss excluding earnout swings barely changed, so this report has to show the losses and cash burn shrinking in dollars.

items.title: Chamath: The “First Victim” of AI Labs Moving Up the Stack Won’t Be Salesforce or ServiceNow
items.summary: Key TakeawaysServiceNow fell 34% last week and 81% of software stocks were down, as investors worried that AI labs will build apps to replace established software. Chamath Palihapitiya expects AI-native startups that resell the labs’ tokens to be hit first, so the selloff in Salesforce and ServiceNow looks aimed at the wrong companies.

items.title: Palantir Is Down 15% in a Year: “Anything Short of a Blowout Is a Sell”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPalantir stock is down 15% over the past year, even though third-quarter revenue rose 96% and its 2026 revenue guidance climbed from 61% growth in February to 91%. The business kept beating, and the drop came from investors paying less for it: the forward P/E fell from 270x in October 2025 to 94x on Nov.
